779:   const sendMessage = useCallback(
780:     async (
781:       text: string,
782:       attachments: ChatAttachmentPayload[] = [],
783:       options: { from?: string } = {},
784:     ) => {
785:       const trimmed = text.trim();
786:       if ((!trimmed && !attachments.length) || streaming) {
787:         return;
788:       }
789: 
790:       // A re-ask replaces the turn it starts from: the old question and the
791:       // answer it got are the same turn, and keeping both would read as a
792:       // conversation the reader never had.
793:       const cut = options.from
794:         ? messages.findIndex((message) => message.id === options.from)
795:         : -1;
796:       const replaced = cut >= 0 ? messages.slice(0, cut) : messages;
797: 
798:       // Files ride only on the newest turn. Re-sending megabytes of base64 with
799:       // every later question would make each turn slower than the last.
800:       const history: ChatMessage[] = [
801:         ...replaced.map((message) =>
802:           message.attachments
803:             ? {
804:                 id: message.id,
805:                 role: message.role,
806:                 content: message.content,
807:                 parts: message.parts,
808:               }
809:             : message,
810:         ),
811:         {
812:           role: "user",
813:           id: newTurnId(),
814:           content: trimmed,
815:           ...(attachments.length ? { attachments } : {}),
816:         },
817:       ];
818:       const assistantIndex = history.length;
819:       const assistantId = newTurnId();
820:       setMessages([
821:         ...history,
822:         { role: "assistant", id: assistantId, content: "", parts: [] },
823:       ]);
824:       setStreaming(true);
825:       setThinkingPhase("health_check");
826:       setOfflineReply(false);
827: 
828:       const controller = new AbortController();
829:       abortRef.current = controller;
830: 
831:       let content = "";
832:       let parts: ChatPart[] = [];
833:       let steps: RunStep[] = [];
834:       let failure: StudioError | null = null;
835:       let terminal = false;
836:       let stopped = false;
837: 
838:       // Prose is appended to the open text part; a surface opens a new one, so
839:       // the transcript keeps the agent's order instead of gathering all prose
840:       // above all cards.
841:       const appendText = (text: string) => {
842:         if (!text) {
843:           return;
844:         }
845:         content += text;
846:         const last = parts[parts.length - 1];
847:         parts =
848:           last?.kind === "text"
849:             ? [...parts.slice(0, -1), { kind: "text", text: last.text + text }]
850:             : [...parts, { kind: "text", text }];
851:       };
852: 
853:       // The turn owns its own timeline, so a finished run stays inspectable and
854:       // the next turn starts from nothing without a reset elsewhere.
855:       const publish = () => {
856:         setMessages((prev) => {
857:           if (prev.length <= assistantIndex) {
858:             return prev;
859:           }
860:           const next = [...prev];
861:           next[assistantIndex] = {
862:             role: "assistant",
863:             id: assistantId,
864:             content,
865:             parts: [...parts],
866:             ...(failure ? { error: failure, retryText: trimmed } : {}),
867:             ...(stopped ? { stopped: true, retryText: trimmed } : {}),
868:             ...(failure || stopped
869:               ? attachments.length
870:                 ? { retryAttachments: attachments }
871:                 : {}
872:               : {}),
873:             ...(steps.length ? { tools: [...steps] } : {}),
874:           };
875:           return next;
876:         });
877:       };
878: 
879:       const handleEvent = (event: RawSseEvent) => {
880:         switch (event.event) {
881:           case "status": {
882:             const phase = String(event.data.phase ?? "");
883:             setThinkingPhase(phase);
884:             if (phase === "offline") {
885:               setOfflineReply(true);
886:             }
887:             break;
888:           }
889:           case "delta": {
890:             appendText(String(event.data.text ?? ""));
891:             publish();
892:             break;
893:           }
894:           case "ui": {
895:             // Validate again on arrival: the connection is local but the
896:             // renderer must never trust a shape it has not checked.
897:             const parsed = parseUiSpec(event.data.spec, catalogManifest());
898:             if (parsed.ok) {
899:               parts = [
900:                 ...parts,
901:                 { kind: "ui", id: String(event.data.id ?? `ui-${parts.length}`), node: parsed.node },
902:               ];
903:               publish();
904:             }
905:             break;
906:           }
907:           case "tool":
908:             steps = applyToolEvent(
909:               steps,
910:               {
911:                 name: String(event.data.name ?? ""),
912:                 status: String(event.data.status ?? ""),
913:                 preview: event.data.preview ? String(event.data.preview) : undefined,
914:               },
915:               Date.now(),
916:             );
917:             publish();
918:             break;
919:           case "message": {
920:             terminal = true;
921:             content = String(event.data.content ?? content);
922:             const hasSurfaces = parts.some((part) => part.kind === "ui");
923:             if (!hasSurfaces) {
924:               parts = content ? [{ kind: "text", text: content }] : [];
925:             }
926:             publish();
927:             break;
928:           }
929:           case "conversation": {
930:             const id = String(event.data.id ?? "");
931:             if (id) {
932:               setConversationId(id);
933:             }
934:             break;
935:           }
936:           case "memory": {
937:             const observation = event.data.observation as Observation | undefined;
938:             if (observation?.id) {
939:               setMemory((prev) =>
940:                 prev.some((item) => item.id === observation.id)
941:                   ? prev.map((item) => (item.id === observation.id ? observation : item))
942:                   : [...prev, observation],
943:               );
944:             }
945:             break;
946:           }
947:           case "canvas_dirty":
948:             void refreshCanvas();
949:             break;
950:           case "connector": {
951:             if (String(event.data.status ?? "") === "error") {
952:               const reason = String(event.data.error ?? "The connector could not be added.");
953:               setMessages((prev) => [
954:                 ...prev,
955:                 { role: "notice", id: newTurnId(), content: `Connector failed: ${reason}` },
956:               ]);
957:             } else {
958:               setConnectorSuggestions((prev) => {
959:                 const id = String(event.data?.preset ?? event.data?.name ?? "");
960:                 if (!id || prev.includes(id)) {
961:                   return prev;
962:                 }
963:                 return [...prev, id];
964:               });
965:             }
966:             void refreshConnectors();
967:             break;
968:           }
969:           case "error": {
970:             terminal = true;
971:             failure = readStudioError(event.data.error);
972:             publish();
973:             break;
974:           }
975:           default:
976:             break;
977:         }
978:       };
979: 
980:       try {
981:         await streamChat(
982:           {
983:             base_url: settings.base_url,
984:             api_key: settings.api_key,
985:             model: settings.model_name,
